name: RRSOS PCC Blueprints
description: At the start of a new game, unlocks the blueprints that are otherwise unlocked by finding blueprint chips (the list is blueprints.txt in the mod's data folder, made from a save), through the game's own unlock. With UnlockStoryBlueprints set to true in the config it also unlocks the ones hidden in the story and the wrecks (treadmill, fridge, indoor bike, shower, lockers, vault, ...; story-blueprints.txt). Nothing that unlocks by terraformation is touched.
